question: Which divine guardian protects the practitioner in the southern direction?
premises: Protection is requested in the south
The lord of mountains is named
inference: Tatpuruṣa, the lord of mountains, is invoked to protect in the southern direction.
uncertainties: girivināyakaḥ interpreted as lord of mountains following legacy hint
plain_english: In the south, may Tatpuruṣa, the lord of mountains, protect me.
